description: A quarterly P&L by department in the Svelte 5 data grid with a boardroom print pack. Print opens a fresh window containing only the printable HTML, a styled cover sheet with company, period, owner and signature line plus a plain table with inlined styles, and calls print() there so no site chrome bleeds onto the paper; a switcher writes Letter, A4 or Legal in portrait or landscape into the popup's @page rule; CSV and HTML downloads reuse the same builder so the file matches the printed sheet; and PDF comes from the browser's native print-to-PDF with no library.

faq.question: Why print from a popup window?
faq.answer: window.print() on the app page prints the sidebar, header and everything else around the grid. A new window with only the printable HTML gives a clean dialog and a document that reads as one report.

faq.question: How are page size and orientation set?
faq.answer: The chosen values are written into an @page rule inside the popup's stylesheet, which the browser's print pipeline honours; the cover sheet ends with a page break so the table starts on page two.

faq.question: Do I need a PDF library?
faq.answer: No. The browser's Save as PDF in the print dialog produces the deliverable. For programmatic PDF export with column formatting see the export demos in @svgrid/enterprise.
